challenge.method: Compared the abstract and title with the primitive description to test whether the label names a distinct programming surface, a coordination protocol, or just a runtime system.
challenge.results: New facilities for bags and coordination occur inside an expressly named ISETL-derived language surface. The local dialect classification reflects the explicit extension and leaves distinct Linda embeddings outside scope.

limitations: This identity denotes the authors' 1995 language design. Its relation to an interpreter or to other variants of Linda is independently scoped.
